note: BH-9823: how long the conductor waits for a pending lead review (a lead_review_requests row on the head, status requested or running) before it consumes the autopilot verdict or enqueues. Past it: one LEAD_REVIEW_OVERDUE warn alert per (PR, head), then the autopilot verdict is used. 2700 = MC_REREVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECS; a lead review runs 7-9 minutes; below MC_BUDGET_WAIT_LEAD (3600). 0 = no wait (the behavior before BH-9823). Settings key lane.merge-conductor.mc_lead_review_wait_s.
